_comment: Thousand Sons army rule (10e) — All Is Dust (faction-gated -1 to wound on D1 attacks) and Cabal of Sorcerers (Shooting-phase Rituals: real 2D6 Psychic test with Doombolt / Temporal Surge / Destiny's Ruin / Twist of Fate). Quoted text is from BSData v10.6.0 (Chaos - Thousand Sons.cat) which carries the verbatim Wahapedia rule descriptions; per-Ritual effect text mirrors the BSData characteristic field. Grand Coven detachment + Kindred Sorcery citation lives at GRAND_COVEN.psychic_mortal_wounds_per_round below.

simulator.all_is_dust.rule_name: All Is Dust (Rubricae Phalanx detachment rule)
simulator.all_is_dust.quoted_text: Each time an attack with an unmodified Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to a RUBRICAE model from your army, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against that attack.
simulator.all_is_dust.trigger: incoming attack has weapon_damage_per_shot == 1.0 AND the defender carries the RUBRICAE unit-keyword (Rubric Marines, Scarab Occult Terminators — both seeded via data/overrides.json since BSData's mapper does not extract sub-faction keywords) AND the defender's army resolves to a detachment with `all_is_dust=True` (Rubricae Phalanx)
simulator.all_is_dust.effect: Improve the defender's armour save by 1 at the save-modifier layer (capped at 2+). Replaces the iter-pre-14 implementation which read All Is Dust as a -1 to wound on D1 attacks for any non-DAEMON TSON unit; that was the 10e launch-index datasheet ability, removed when the codex landed and replaced with the Rubricae Phalanx detachment +1 save rule documented here. iter15: the iter-14 APPROXIMATION (apply buff regardless of detachment) is FIXED — the buff is now gated on the defender's army carrying the Rubricae Phalanx detachment (`Detachment.all_is_dust` flag). Real-meta TSON is Rubricae Phalanx in May 2026, so `DEFAULT_BY_FACTION['Thousand Sons'] = 'rubricae_phalanx'` keeps the unconditional path working for the common case; armies that explicitly pick Grand Coven (psyker-heavy lists) lose the save buff — matches the codex. The remaining APPROXIMATION: codex says 'unmodified Damage 1'; SwegHammer's per_shot_dmg has already absorbed Melta range bonuses (the only +damage modifier in 10e), so a D1 Melta weapon (very rare) would lose the buff under our reading.

simulator.rites_of_coalescence.rule_name: Rites of Coalescence (Scarab Occult Terminators datasheet ability)
simulator.rites_of_coalescence.quoted_text: While this unit contains one or more PSYKER models, each time an attack targets this unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll.
simulator.rites_of_coalescence.trigger: defender's profile.name == 'Scarab Occult Terminators' AND the defender carries the PSYKER unit-keyword (the Aspiring Sorcerer in the squad is mandatory and is the PSYKER carrier; the keyword check is a sanity gate that the squad still contains a PSYKER model — which is effectively always-on while the squad has at least one model left, since the Sorcerer dies last by default)
simulator.rites_of_coalescence.effect: Apply -1 to the wound_mod_delta when this unit is the defender. Composes with the ±1 wound-modifier cap; if an attacker already enjoys +1 to wound (e.g. detachment buff or stratagem), Rites cancels it down to the base wound target. The buff fires on ANY damage characteristic (D1, D2, D3+) — distinct from All Is Dust which is D1-only — making Scarab Occult Terminators meaningfully more durable against heavy weapons than a vanilla 2+/4++ Terminator.

simulator.cabal_of_sorcerers.quoted_text: If your army Faction is Thousand Sons, at the start of your Shooting phase, one or more models from your army with this ability can attempt Rituals. To do so, select one model from your army with this ability that has not yet attempted a Ritual this turn and select one Ritual no model from your army has attempted to manifest this turn, then take a Psychic test by following the sequence below: 1. Roll 2D6 2. Optionally, roll one additional D6 (Channel the Warp). Then, if one or more doubles or triples were rolled during this test, that model's unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. 3. If that model is not destroyed, the combined total of all the dice rolled during this test is the Psychic test result. If this equals or exceeds the Warp Charge value of the Ritual being attempted, that model manifests that Ritual and you resolve its effects.
simulator.cabal_of_sorcerers.trigger: start of Shooting phase for a Thousand Sons army; each alive PSYKER model with this ability may attempt one Ritual per turn, each Ritual type at most once per army per turn
simulator.cabal_of_sorcerers.effect: (approximation) the simulator rolls 2D6 (no Channel the Warp — declined for determinism), greedy-picks the highest unmanifested Ritual whose Warp Charge <= test total, and resolves its effect via _cabal_resolve_ritual. The Channel the Warp doubles/triples mortal-wound penalty is therefore never paid; in real play the AI would gate Channel on test margin, which we elide. Hooked at the round-start barrier alongside _apply_detachment_stratagems because the simulator's per-unit shoot loop has no separate Shooting-phase-start barrier. Per-unit deduplication (wave-53 fix `ab1f4b8`): the simulator decomposes squads into one Unit object per model; alive PSYKER units are grouped by profile name, then one representative per (min_models) block is yielded — so a 5-man Rubric Marines squad contributes 1 attempt (one Aspiring Sorcerer), not 5. TSON-CABAL-GEN-V1 amendment: for multi-model INFANTRY squads (min_models > 1), the representative count is additionally capped by max_models // min_models (e.g. Rubric Marines max=10, min=5 → cap 2 squad representatives per profile type per army) to prevent random_fill-generated third-squad slots from inflating ritual attempts beyond what tournament-legal armies typically carry. Characters (min_models == 1) are uncapped: each separate CHARACTER unit instance is a distinct codex model with its own Cabal attempt.

simulator.ritual_doombolt.quoted_text: Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model (excluding units with the Lone Operative ability that are not part of an Attached unit and are not within 12" of the manifesting model); that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. If the Psychic test result for this Ritual was 11+, that unit suffers D3+3 mortal wounds instead.
simulator.ritual_doombolt.trigger: manifested as part of the Cabal of Sorcerers ritual pass with Warp Charge >= 7; one Doombolt per turn army-wide
simulator.ritual_doombolt.effect: (approximation) the highest-threat enemy takes 2 mortal wounds (median of D3), or 5 mortal wounds (median of D3+3) if the 2D6 Psychic test rolled 11+. SwegHammer collapses the D3 / D3+3 rolls to medians (matches the deterministic-MW convention used for Reanimation Protocols, Tank Shock). Target picked via _highest_threat_enemy; 24" range gate is not enforced (the simulator's targeting picks the highest role-weighted enemy regardless of distance).

simulator.ritual_temporal_surge.quoted_text: Select one friendly Thousand Sons or Scintillating Legion unit that is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units and is within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. That unit can make a Normal move of up to D6". If the Psychic test result for this Ritual was 10+, that model can make a Normal move of up to 6" instead. In either case, until the end of the turn, that unit is not eligible to declare a charge.
simulator.ritual_temporal_surge.trigger: manifested as part of the Cabal of Sorcerers ritual pass with Warp Charge >= 6; one Temporal Surge per turn army-wide
simulator.ritual_temporal_surge.effect: (approximation) the highest-DPA friendly PSYKER gets transient_assault_this_round set, letting it shoot after Advancing. SwegHammer's activation loop drives movement per-unit and we don't have a separate pre-shoot reposition hook; the assault-keyword swap captures the offensive uplift of 'move further AND shoot' that the Normal-move-of-D6" represents in the codex. The 'not eligible to declare a charge' restriction is not separately enforced — the simulator's charge AI almost never selects PSYKER chassis as chargers anyway.

simulator.ritual_destinys_ruin.quoted_text: Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. Until the end of the phase, each time a Thousand Sons or Scintillating Legion model from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, re-roll a Hit roll of 1. If the Psychic test result for this Ritual was 10+, you can re-roll the Hit roll instead.
simulator.ritual_destinys_ruin.trigger: manifested as part of the Cabal of Sorcerers ritual pass with Warp Charge >= 5; one Destiny's Ruin per turn army-wide
simulator.ritual_destinys_ruin.effect: (approximation, NO-OP) the per-target re-roll-1s-to-hit buff does not have a transient flag indexed by target unit in the simulator. The Ritual slot is marked used (so it can't be re-picked this turn) but no mechanical buff is applied. TODO: add a target-indexed hit-reroll table to wire this real-rule effect.

simulator.ritual_twist_of_fate.quoted_text: Select one enemy unit within 24" of and visible to the manifesting model. Until the end of the phase, each time a Thousand Sons or Scintillating Legion model from your army makes an attack that targets that unit, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 1. If the Psychic test result for this Ritual was 12+, improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of that attack by 2 instead.
simulator.ritual_twist_of_fate.trigger: manifested as part of the Cabal of Sorcerers ritual pass with Warp Charge >= 9; one Twist of Fate per turn army-wide
simulator.ritual_twist_of_fate.effect: (approximation, NO-OP) the per-target +1 AP buff requires a target-indexed weapon-mod table the simulator doesn't expose. The Ritual slot is marked used (cap of one Twist of Fate per turn upheld) but no mechanical buff is applied. TODO: per-target AP buff plumbing.

simulator.ahriman_arch_sorcerer.quoted_text: Each time this model attempts a Ritual, add 1 to the Psychic test result.
simulator.ahriman_arch_sorcerer.trigger: Ahriman attempts a Cabal of Sorcerers Ritual
simulator.ahriman_arch_sorcerer.effect: Add +1 flat to the 2D6 Psychic test total when the manifesting psyker is Ahriman. Composes with the WC threshold check and with the 11+/10+/12+ crit thresholds for Doombolt/Temporal Surge/Twist of Fate (a 2D6=10 Doombolt becomes effective 11 and triggers the D3+3 crit). Ahriman attempts 1 Ritual per turn (not 2 — that's Magnus). iter21 wiring: Ahriman was previously bonus-less in the Cabal pass, leaving his 100pt EPIC HERO PSYKER datasheet ability unmodelled. Quoted text from BSData v10.6.0 (Chaos - Thousand Sons.cat.gz, Ahriman datasheet, Abilities > Arch-Sorcerer of Tzeentch (Psychic)).

simulator.magnus_unearthly_power_impossi.rule_name: Unearthly Power / Impossible Form (Crimson King, Psychic)
simulator.magnus_unearthly_power_impossi.quoted_text: Unearthly Power: At the start of the battle round, select one of the abilities in the Crimson King section. Until the start of the next battle round, this model has that ability. Impossible Form (Psychic): Each time an attack is made against this Psyker (excluding Psychic Attacks), subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of that attack.
simulator.magnus_unearthly_power_impossi.trigger: Magnus the Red is alive at round start; default-pick Impossible Form (the most-damage-sponging of the three Crimson King options)
simulator.magnus_unearthly_power_impossi.effect: The simulator sets `transient_minus_one_damage_taken=True` on Magnus at round start, which reduces incoming damage by 1 (floor of 1) in `Unit.receive_damage`. The codex Psychic-Attack exclusion IS now wired: `receive_damage` accepts a `psychic: bool=False` parameter, and the two simulator-side psychic-source call sites (Cabal of Sorcerers Doombolt in `_dispatch_ritual`, end-of-round psychic-detachment mortal-wound payload in `_apply_psychic_phase`) pass `psychic=True`, which causes the -1-damage clamp to skip. Note: 10e [PSYCHIC] weapon-keyword tagging on RANGED profiles is NOT modelled (BSData mapper does not extract it), so ranged Psychic-keyword weapons (which are rare anyway) still pass through as non-psychic and get -1'd. Closes the TSON-MAGNUS carry-forward from TSON-DIAG. APPROXIMATION (still): the player picks one of three Crimson King abilities each round (Impossible Form / Treason of Tzeentch / Time Flux); we always pick Impossible Form. The other two (Time Flux +2" Move aura on TSON, Treason of Tzeentch HAZARDOUS on a target enemy's ranged weapons) require movement-aura and opponent-weapon-mod plumbing the simulator does not expose. Wired in `_run_round` after `_run_cabal_rituals` so the flag is set every round Magnus remains alive. Quoted text from BSData v10.6.0 (Chaos - Thousand Sons.cat.gz, Magnus the Red datasheet, Abilities > Unearthly Power and Crimson King > Impossible Form (Psychic)).

simulator.magnus_lord_of_the_planet.rule_name: Lord of the Planet of the Sorcerers (Psychic)
simulator.magnus_lord_of_the_planet.quoted_text: This model can attempt up to 2 Rituals per turn instead of one, and each time this model attempts a Ritual, add 2 to the Psychic test result.
simulator.magnus_lord_of_the_planet.trigger: the manifesting psyker for a Cabal of Sorcerers Ritual is Magnus the Red
simulator.magnus_lord_of_the_planet.effect: Magnus attempts 2 Rituals per turn (the simulator's per-psyker attempt loop runs twice for Magnus instead of once), and the 2D6 Psychic test result is incremented by 2 on each of his attempts (composes with the WC threshold check AND with the 11+/10+/12+ crit thresholds for Doombolt / Temporal Surge / Twist of Fate, so a 2D6=9 roll becomes a 11 effective and triggers the Doombolt D3+3 crit). Quoted text comes from BSData v10.6.0 (Chaos - Thousand Sons.cat.gz, Magnus the Red datasheet, Abilities > Lord of the Planet of the Sorcerers (Psychic)) which mirrors the Wahapedia datasheet entry. iter20 wiring — closes the iter18/19 finding that Magnus's psychic MW output was unwired, leaving the 435pt EPIC HERO PSYKER MONSTER undervalued in the simulator (TSON sim 31.7% vs real 54.6% at 2000pt archetype eval).
